raw_text: The viral MoD circular looks fake to me. Several red flags: (1) The letterhead uses the old MoD logo that was replaced in 2022, (2) The file numbering format MoD/TS/2024/8834 is wrong — actual MoD file numbers use a different convention, (3) There are spelling errors in the body text that would never pass through official channels. Classic disinformation.
clean_text: Analysis of viral MoD circular identifies multiple red flags: outdated letterhead logo, incorrect file numbering format, and spelling errors inconsistent with official communications.
